She has also worked in theatre, radio and film. She won the 2013 Olivier Award for Best Supporting Actress for the play The Curious Incident of the Dog in the Night-Time, and has twice been nominated for the BAFTA TV Award for Best Supporting Actress for the BBC drama Last Tango in Halifax.BornMay 15, 1970More at IMDbProContact infoAgent infoResumeBornMay 15, 1970IMDbProStarmeterTop 5,000347Add to favorite peopleView contact info at IMDbPro Nominated for 2 BAFTA Awards10 nominations totalPhotos33+ 27 Known forMI-58.3TV SeriesRuth Evershed2003–2011 • 57 epsUnforgotten8.4TV SeriesDCI Cassie Stuart2015–2021 • 24 epsRiver7.9TV Mini SeriesDS Jackie 'Stevie' Stevenson2015 • 6 epsFour Weddings and a Funeral7.1Frightful Folk Duo -
